title: DWG AcDs versus versioned DXF SAT/SAB route review
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and implementation-readiness refinement
scope: Reconcile ODA DWG DataStorage offset and Blob01 roles with current peer extraction code
Separate DWG AcDs carriers from versioned DXF SAT and ACDSDATA/SAB representations
Refresh open-source ACIS parser and downstream consumer evidence boundaries
Name the next falsifiable generated fast check without increasing routine validation cost

sources.project: Open Design Alliance DWG specification v5.4.1
sources.observation: DataIndex rows address Data segments and locate record headers relative to the segment stream start. Record payload offsets are relative to the data-start marker; neighboring sorted offsets bound payloads. Blob01 pages are reached through blob-reference records. The record-header second UInt32 is described as unknown, although ODA writes 1.
sources.limits: The AcDs description does not specify ACIS topology semantics or prove a downstream consumer accepts the assembled payload. The ODA-written unknown value is not promoted to a universal invariant.

sources.observation: The AcDs source parses the directory and DataIndex/schema/search metadata, but its segment switch still leaves _data_ and blob01 unhandled. A later extraction pass scans for ACIS/SAB markers and consumes queued handles. The shared modeler-family predicate includes 3DSOLID, REGION, BODY, and several surfaces.
sources.limits: This is not a per-record offset/page-to-handle oracle. ODA explicitly names REGION and 3DSOLID for DataStorage ACIS records; other entity families need producer-backed route evidence. Mutable master is not pinned to a release package.

sources.observation: The public 3DSOLID reference identifies AcDbModelerGeometry, modeler format version, proprietary group-1 text with optional group-3 continuation strings, and the AcDb3dSolid group-350 history pointer.
sources.limits: This entity page does not make DWG AcDs DataStorage interchangeable with DXF modeler groups or establish ACIS interpretation.

sources.observation: The documentation describes SAT for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB for R2013+, supports raw ACIS browsing/export, and warns that only a limited number of ACIS entities are supported; unsupported entities become NONE_ENTITY and their data is lost.
sources.limits: Not an arbitrary ACIS round-trip or general B-rep semantic oracle.

sources.project: FreeCAD documentation and source project status
sources.observation: The checked-in Draft DXF page says stock FreeCAD does not read ACIS solids; GitHub marks the documentation repository archived on 2026-04-01.
sources.limits: Use only as route background. Any native qualification must record the tested FreeCAD build, platform, importer selection, converter, and effective options.

sources.observation: The project lists selected SAT/SAB/ASM versions and bounded supported geometry, retains unsupported records, and raises on unsupported conversion profiles.
sources.limits: Parsing does not imply conversion completeness. Its CadQuery/OpenCascade route is not an independent kernel vote for OCCT-based consumers.

sources.observation: The local implementation separates DataIndex record rows from Blob01 descriptor pages and has generated role/alignment controls. A new generated in-range false-boundary control points into a neighboring payload; the parser marks the section invalid/non-replayable, withholds the overlapping records, and preserves exact bytes for independently bounded records.
sources.limits: The conservative refusal is not evidence that a malformed source record can be recovered; no production defect or heuristic boundary repair was established.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Made the DWG AcDs, legacy DXF SAT text, and AC1027+ ACDSDATA/SAB routes explicit and separate; tightened peer roles; added a conditional false-boundary generated probe before any production parser change.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Continue to remaining Blob01/page-chain boundary coverage in the existing graph-preservation test owner; retain the generated false-boundary control as a fail-closed regression guard.

method.limitations: Peer source branches and documentation may change. No peer behavior, CAD runtime, or ACIS kernel semantics were reproduced; all support claims remain profile- and route-specific.

validation.commitBlocker: No commit requested; the shared worktree contains extensive existing changes and nothing was staged.
